items.name: Potion
items.description: A spray bottle of medicine. Smells faintly of mint.

items.name: Oran Berry
items.description: A round blue berry that grows in the Whispering Forest. Sweet and a little sour.

items.name: Wood
items.description: A sturdy piece of timber gathered from fallen branches and old logs.

items.name: Stone
items.description: A rough stone gathered from small outcrops. Heavy, but useful.

items.name: Fruit
items.description: Fresh wild fruit picked from a low bush. Sweet enough to lift your spirits.

items.name: Old Map
items.description: A faded map of the region. Someone has circled Brookside Town in red ink.

items.name: House Key
items.description: A small brass key on a string. It must open a door somewhere nearby.

items.name: Pearl
items.description: A smooth pink pearl from the tiny island in Brookside Bay. It shimmers in the light.

items.name: Old Compass
items.description: The hermit's brass compass. However you turn it, the needle points back to Brookside Town.
